comment: Real consumer entry points executed by Org Gate O2b at each repo's exact pinned SHA. The central gate only orchestrates: it checks out the pin, runs the repo's own build + frozen install, asserts the pinned canonical package versions, and executes the repo's own test command.

consumers.note: AEP adapters (aep-v0_2, canonical-drift) consume canonical aep/v0.5 records.
AgentBOM core validates against the canonical protocol contract.

excluded.reason: TR-2 removed wasmagent-protocol — the repo never imported it (AEPRecord/EpochEvidenceBundle are repo-local types). Not an AEP consumer; covered by O1 only.
Vendored-schema byte integrity is O2a drift checking, not runtime consumer execution.
